summary: Input's label, helper and error move off the box edge onto the text lane. The label, helper and error now start where the typed text does: the control's hairline plus its inline padding (lib/field-lane), so they share one edge at every size and density. At default density that is 13.5px at lg and 9.5px at md and sm. A full (capsule) field's lane is 4px further in, and a field with no shape follows the brand's --ui-field-shape-inset.
